headlines.description: — Kyle Manzardo hit a grand slam, Chase DeLauter scored the go-ahead run on a sacrifice bunt in the eighth inning and the Cleveland Guardians snapped a five-game losing streak, rallying for a 6-5 victory over the Cincinnati Reds on Tuesday in the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Manzardo hits 1st grand slam, Guardians rally for 6-5 win over Reds in Game 1 of doubleheader

headlines.description: — James McCann singled in the winning run in the 12th inning with his fourth hit of the game and the Arizona Diamondbacks held on for an 8-7 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates on Tuesday night despite blowing a six-run lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: James McCann's 12th-inning single gives Diamondbacks 8-7 win over Pirates after blowing six-run lead

headlines.description: — Eduardo Valencia homered twice and drove in four runs, Gleyber Torres had a home run and five RBI, and the Detroit Tigers scored in every inning they went to the plate in a 14-0 win over the Baltimore Orioles on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tigers score in every inning of 14-0 rout of the Orioles

headlines.description: — Sandy Alcantara pitched four-hit ball over seven sharp innings, Kyle Stowers homered and the Miami Marlins beat the Philadelphia Phillies 1-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alcantara works 7 strong innings, Stowers homers to lead Marlins past Phillies 1-0

events.name: Texas Rangers at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Austin Wynns homered, Cal Quantrill struck out seven and the Texas Rangers beat the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 on Tuesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wynns, Quantrill power Rangers to 4th win in 5 games, 4-1 over the Rays

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Washington Nationals

headlines.description: — The Nationals drew six walks against former Cy Young Award winner Shane Bieber in a four-run first inning, and Washington beat the Toronto Blue Jays 8-6...
headlines.shortLinkText: Nationals draw 6 walks against Shane Bieber in 4-run first inning, beat Blue Jays 8-6

events.name: Atlanta Braves at New York Mets

headlines.description: — The Atlanta Braves’ game at the New York Mets that was scheduled for Tuesday night was postponed because of heavy rain in the forecast.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mets-Braves game postponed amid forecast of heavy rain, will play doubleheader Wednesday

headlines.description: — JJ Bleday hit a solo home run in the first inning and five Cincinnati pitchers combined for the shutout as the Reds defeated the Cleveland Guardians 2-0 and split a day-night doubleheader Tuesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: JJ Bleday's solo homer and Dane Myers' game-saving grab help Reds beat Guardians 2-0

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Minnesota Twins

headlines.description: — Royce Lewis hit a two-run triple with two outs in the bottom of the ninth inning to give the Minnesota Twins a 3-2 victory over the Kansas City Royals on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Royce Lewis hits walk-off triple as Twins rally past Royals 3-2 after Buxton exits with sore hip

events.name: New York Yankees at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Gerrit Cole pitched six shutout innings of four-hit ball and the New York Yankees beat the Chicago White Sox 3-2 on Tuesday night for their fifth victory in six games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gerrit Cole throws 6 scoreless innings for the Yankees in a 3-2 win over the White Sox

events.name: Chicago Cubs at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Seiya Suzuki, Ian Happ and Nico Hoerner drove in two runs apiece and the Chicago Cubs jumped out to a seven-run lead after two innings on the way to a 10-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cubs race to an early 7-run lead on the way to a 10-2 win over the Cardinals

events.name: Houston Astros at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Yordan Alvarez homered and hit a go-ahead RBI single with two outs in the ninth inning to lift the Houston Astros to a 3-2 win over the Los Angeles Angels on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alvarez homers in first inning and hits RBI single in ninth to lead Astros to 3-2 win over Angels

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — Brian Serven hit his first major league home run in almost four years and rookie Gage Jump pitched six scoreless innings as the Athletics cooled off the Boston Red Sox with a 4-3 victory Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brian Serven hits 1st MLB homer since 2022 and Jump pitches A's to 4-3 win over Red Sox

events.name: Colorado Rockies at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Fernando Tatis Jr. went 5 for 5 with two RBI in the first five-hit game of his career, and Xander Bogaerts' sacrifice fly in the bottom of the ninth inning gave the San Diego Padres an 8-7 victory over the Colorado Rockies on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fernando Tatis Jr. goes 5 for 5 and Padres top Rockies 8-7 on Xander Bogaerts’ sac fly in 9th

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Brice Turang had three hits and two RBI as the Milwaukee Brewers beat the San Francisco Giants 8-2 on Tuesday night behind Logan Henderson.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brice Turang paces Brewers offense in 8-2 win over Giants

events.name: Seattle Mariners at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Dominic Canzone hit a tiebreaking, two-run homer — his second longball of the game and fifth for Seattle — in the eighth inning to rally the Mariners past the Los Angeles Dodgers 7-6 on Tuesday night in their series opener.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dominic Canzone’s 2-run homer in the 8th lifts the Mariners over the Dodgers 7-6
